subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should session workspace file metadata ever expose existence, size, and mtime for transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace boundary?
rationale: The PR changes a read-scoped Gateway boundary from fs-safe workspace metadata to raw host filesystem stats, which is a product/security policy choice rather than a routine code cleanup.

options.title: Keep Metadata Inside Workspace
options.body: Remove the raw stat fallback, keep metadata behind fs-safe containment, and solve the UX with filtering or neutral external status plus directory/symlink tests.

options.title: Allow External Metadata
options.body: Accept transcript-mentioned external metadata as intentional after explicit security review and add protocol/UI tests for the new contract.

options.title: Split Layout First
options.body: Land or keep the already-merged layout path separately while leaving backend external-file semantics on the linked issue.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Inside Workspace
recommendation.body: Remove the raw stat fallback, keep metadata behind fs-safe containment, and solve the UX with filtering or neutral external status plus directory/symlink tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original workspace rail PR and the later overlapping rail layout fixes, so they are the best routing candidate for the boundary choice.
